hooks.text: 每次战败都会重生的克隆英雄，与能发射多种弹药的活体鲨鱼并肩突围
hooks.excerpt: In a world taken over by cybernetic monkeys, humanity seeks hope in the form of a clone that is reborn after each defeat. To aid him in his mission, a living shark weapon becomes his most loyal ally against hordes of enemies in a frantic battle.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 鲨鱼储存不同弹种，永久技能树、房间强化、商人物品与无人机共同构筑
hooks.excerpt: With your shark weapon, you have the unique ability to store various types of shots. Your cleverness in choosing the ideal shot for each situation will be crucial. Additionally, a skill tree provides permanent improvements, while each room grants you a new upgrade. And to further enhance your options, a merchant will offer new items and drones that can be essential in your combat journey.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 角色记忆与新NPC的不同视角逐层揭开霓虹城反转真相
hooks.excerpt: With each new memory about the characters' past, our hero will find himself in a more complex and mysterious plot. New characters may appear, each providing their own perspective on what might be happening in the world of Neon City. Interact with NPCs and discover valuable information.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
